test_modes.name: Avalon-MM master debug
test_modes.purpose: JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master / System Console drives read/write transfers for in-system register access.

test_modes.name: Protocol assertion checking
test_modes.purpose: Simulation-time checks of Avalon-MM/Avalon-ST handshake legality.

test_modes.name: SignalTap probing
test_modes.purpose: Capture Avalon signals on-chip for debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: Avalon-MM response
spec_provided_observability.purpose: OKAY/SLAVEERROR/DECODEERROR response codes report transfer success/failure to the host.

spec_provided_observability.name: debugaccess signal
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Marks an Avalon-MM transfer as a debug access (e.g. from a debugger), allowing agents to permit otherwise-restricted accesses.

spec_provided_observability.name: waitrequest / readdatavalid timing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable wait-state and pipelined-read behavior for bring-up and protocol checking.

spec_provided_observability.name: Avalon-ST error bits
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-beat error qualifier reports data errors on a stream.

spec_provided_observability.name: System Console / Avalon-MM master probes
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Intel tools (System Console, JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master) issue Avalon-MM transfers for in-system debug.

error_detection_mechanisms: Avalon-MM response codes (SLAVEERROR, DECODEERROR) flag failed / unmapped transfers.
Avalon-ST error bits flag per-beat data errors.
byteenable mismatch / illegal access is reported by the agent via response.
Protocol checkers (Platform Designer / simulation) verify waitrequest, readdatavalid, and ready/valid timing rules.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: An interrupt sender asserts irq to the receiver (processor).
Avalon-ST error bits asserted with a beat.
Sink deasserts ready / agent asserts waitrequest.

notes: Avalon's protocol-level test surface is the response/error qualifiers, the debugaccess signal, the irq interrupt mechanism, and the observability of the handshake signals. Intel tools (System Console, JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master, SignalTap) provide in-system Avalon access; chip-level scan/BIST remain device/SoC concerns.
